newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends higher on foreign fund inflows.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends higher on foreign fund inflows.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed higher against its American counterpart on Friday as foreign funds flowed into the local stock market, dealers said.
The local unit ended at T$27.468 against Thursday's T$27.482 close. Turnover was an active US$231.5 million.
Dealers noted slowing month-end demand for U.S. dollars.

"Once foreign funds entered, the Taiwan dollar easily moved upward," said one dealer. "Exporters followed suit, selling U.S. dollars," he said. "Overall, foreign funds likely will continue to push up the Taiwan dollar, but no sharp rises are expected in coming sessions." -- James Peng (5080815)
